Made in India.Built for the world.

Drones, AI, robotics and hardware, engineered end to end.

Every day, brilliant ideas are born in India's labs, classrooms and garages. Too many never leave the whiteboard. Not for lack of talent, but for lack of a team that can build them end to end.

So we became that team.

Complete system builders, not just designers or software vendors.

Intiv India turns raw ideas into real-world, deployable products. We engineer and deliver full software platforms, AI systems, complete drone systems, robotics, embedded electronics and manufacturing-ready hardware.

From ideato impact.

One team carries your product through every stage, so nothing is lost in a hand-off.

  1. 01 of 06

    Ideation

    We start by deeply understanding your vision. Through collaborative workshops we define the problem, explore possibilities and crystallize the product direction.

  2. 02 of 06

    Design

    Our architects craft the technical blueprint: system design, component architecture and user flows that balance ambition with feasibility.

  3. 03 of 06

    Build

    Cross-functional teams bring the design to life in agile sprints with continuous integration, whether it is software, hardware or both.

  4. 04 of 06

    Validate

    Rigorous testing across every dimension (functional, performance, security and user acceptance) so the product meets the highest standard.

  5. 05 of 06

    Deploy

    We handle production deployment, documentation and knowledge transfer, so your team is ready to take full ownership.

  6. 06 of 06

    Scale

    Post-launch support, optimization and scaling strategy help your product grow from MVP to market leader.
